summary: REST and MCP variants each assert byte-identical (status_code, json body) equality against the shared SCOPE_FAILURE constant for an existing-unrelated-task dep id vs. a nonexistent dep id, driven against the real mounted app (SqlAlchemyStore, real ASGI middleware); an implementation that leaked existence (e.g. 404 for missing vs 403 for unrelated, or a differing body) would fail both tests.
